customManagers.description: Track the pinned actionlint (workflow linter) release in actionlint.yml via github-releases. Renovate bumps ONLY ACTIONLINT_VERSION; the download URL derives from it in the run-script, so version + URL can't drift. The adjacent ACTIONLINT_SHA256 cannot come from Renovate (github-releases exposes the git-tag digest, not the release tarball's checksum), so the postUpgradeTask rule below refreshes it in the same commit. If the task cannot run, the actionlint job's own `sha256sum -c` fails loudly on the mismatch, so a stale hash can never silently ship.

Track cargo-zigbuild, the cross-linker build tool pinned in taiki-e/install-action's `tool:` input in ci.yml and knope-release.yml. github-actions pins the install-action `uses:` SHA but does not parse the `tool:` value, so the pinned build-tool version was invisible. crates.io datasource. Follows the base auto-merge policy: ci.yml builds with it on the PR.

packageRules.description: Hold the MSRV job's Rust toolchain at the DECLARED minimum (Cargo.toml rust-version = 1.96). ci.yml's `build (MSRV 1.96)` job exists to prove the crate still builds on that floor; letting Renovate track it toward stable silently stops verifying the MSRV. Bump it only alongside a deliberate rust-version raise. (scratchsmith is the only repo in the fleet with a pinned MSRV job; siblings track stable.)

Supply-chain cooldown: soak every update for 7 days before it may merge (auto-merges included), so a freshly-published or yanked release can't land the same day it appears — fitting for a supply-chain tool. Security fixes stay immediate via the shared default's vulnerabilityAlerts (minimumReleaseAge: null).
Digests and pins carry no release date, so the release-age soak can never pass and Renovate would suppress or never merge them. Exempt them from the soak.

Refresh the actionlint sha256 in-branch on a version bump: scripts/check_binary_dep_pins.py --fix rewrites ACTIONLINT_SHA256 in actionlint.yml from GitHub's published asset digest (ported from clauster). Auto-merges on green CI under the base policy: actionlint runs only in CI. The command must be on RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS.
